description: This file contains SCSS styles for implementing a CSS reset and base styles such as box-sizing, typography, links, forms, tables, and miscellaneous UI elements. It is a Sass partial (_reboot.scss) used to normalize styles across browsers and set foundational styles for the project.
external_files: sass mixins and variables used in the file (e.g., font-size, border-radius, include directives)
